item.description:
### Changed
- History shows what can be done with a recording as buttons — Trim, Save as GIF, Save as MP4, and Compress for each platform — instead of a menu under one button.
### Fixed
- The progress of a compression changes in place, instead of sliding in again at every step. - In History, Move to Trash, Copy and Show in Finder act on all the picked captures (⌘-click, ⇧-click), not only the one clicked; Undo brings them all back. With several picked, the panel shows them together — how many, how large, and the actions that act on all.
